Consequently, `log.error("Error while canceling scheduled workflow reminders", error)` is unreachable and any failure to cancel the prior booking's scheduled email/SMS is silently lost. When a SendGrid cancel fails (e.g., within the 60‑minute window, rate limit, or 100‑pending‑cancel cap), the user keeps receiving the old reminder for the rescheduled booking while the new booking proceeds.

The next run will only re-pick those whose `scheduledDate` is still within the next hour; everything else is silently lost and the email goes out. Consider processing each reminder in its own try/catch (or `Promise.allSettled`) so a single failure does not abort the rest.
